title: Gate merges into shahab on Copilot finishing its review
tldr: PRs into shahab can no longer be merged while Copilot is still reviewing the latest push.
why: Copilot's review is required, but its check never reports on the PR, so requiring it directly blocked every PR forever.
intent: Make 'Copilot has reviewed this exact commit' a real merge condition without blocking PRs indefinitely.

what.title: New gate workflow
what.detail: copilot-review-gate waits for Copilot's review run on the PR head commit and mirrors its result.

what.title: Ruleset update
what.detail: The shahab ruleset now requires copilot-review-gate instead of Copilot's own check.

decisions.decision: Poll the check-runs API instead of waiting for a review event
decisions.reason: Copilot's run is a dynamic workflow that is not part of the PR's check rollup.
A single failed API call must not fail the merge gate.

risks: If Copilot does not start within 15 minutes the gate fails and has to be re-run.
out_of_scope: Changing how Copilot itself reviews code.

review_discussion.topic: Transient gh api errors failed the gate

questions.question: Why does the ruleset require copilot-review-gate rather than Copilot's own check?
options: Copilot's check never reports on the PR, so requiring it would block every PR

questions.question: What happens when the GitHub API briefly fails while the gate is polling?
options: The gate fails and the PR is blocked
The gate retries on the next poll
